cards.title: Angular Router
cards.content:
Routing

The Angular Router enables navigation from one view to the next as users perform application tasks.

You define an array of Routes mapping URL paths to components.

const routes: Routes = [
  { path: 'home', component: HomeComponent },
  { path: '', redirectTo: '/home', pathMatch: 'full' }
];

cards.title: Router Outlet & Link
cards.content:
Displaying Routes

The <router-outlet> directive is a placeholder where the router renders the component for the active route.

The routerLink directive links to different routes, preventing full page reloads.

<a routerLink="/home">Home</a>
<router-outlet></router-outlet>

cards.title: Route Parameters & Wildcards
cards.content:
Dynamic and Fallback Routes

Use a colon (:) to define route parameters: { path: 'user/:id', component: UserComponent }.

A wildcard route (**) catches all undefined paths, useful for 404 pages: { path: '**', component: PageNotFoundComponent }.
